tokens.name: ink-base
tokens.usage: Page ground and every other full-width band. Text on ember, ember-bright and cream fills.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet inset areas on ink-base: footer ground, admin sidebar, calendar frame.

tokens.name: ink-raised
tokens.usage: Alternating charcoal band, cards, form field fill, dialogs.

tokens.name: ink-line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Under 3:1 on ink, so never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Main text on ink-base, ink-soft and ink-raised. Fill of the occasional cream band, cream button and cream package panel. Never pure white.

tokens.name: cream-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and eyebrows on ink-base, ink-soft and ink-raised.

tokens.name: cream-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, placeholders and control borders on ink-base (4.9:1) and ink-raised (4.5:1). Not for text on cream.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: The only accent. One word per headline, primary button fill, eyebrow dot, focus ring, selected calendar day. Text on ink-base (6.1:1) and ink-raised. On cream it is 2.8:1, so use ember-heat for the accent word there. Labels on an ember fill are ink-base, never cream.

tokens.name: ember-bright
tokens.usage: Ember's bright step: timeline years, second package panel, tip card fill. Text on ink surfaces, ink-base text on its fill.

tokens.name: ember-heat
tokens.usage: Errors: invalid field border, error banner edge and icon (3.5:1 on ink-base, 3.2:1 on ink-raised, so marks and borders only). Error wording itself is set in cream. Also the accent word on cream bands (4.8:1).

tokens.name: ember-glow
tokens.usage: Radial glows behind key sections and hover lift on ember. Decorative, never text below 24px.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Hero lines at 1440. Fluid: clamp(64px, 12.4vw, 210px). Uppercase, width 80.

styles.name: display-hero-phone
styles.usage: Hero lines at 390, the floor of the clamp.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Section headlines on desktop, footer brand name.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: List row titles, package titles on desktop, big stat numbers.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section headlines on phone, booking reference, timeline years.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Card titles, step numbers, dialog titles.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Wood fire, apple-wood smoke, served warm.
styles.usage: Scrubbed 'who we are' paragraph on desktop. 26px on phone.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, field help and error text, legends.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow with an 8px ember dot in front.

styles.name: admin-title
styles.usage: Admin page and block titles. No display face in tables or forms.

styles.name: admin-meta
styles.usage: Admin column heads, chip labels, badges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps, calendar cell gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label to field, list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field stack gap, admin block padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on phone, grid gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a headline and its content.

tokens.name: gutter-phone
tokens.usage: Page side gutter at 390.

tokens.name: gutter-desktop
tokens.usage: Page side gutter at 1440.

tokens.name: section-phone
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a band at 390.

tokens.name: section-desktop
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a band at 1440.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of pill buttons and form fields.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target: calendar days, stepper buttons, admin row actions.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Form fields, small cards, calendar days, admin blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Step cards, tip card, dialogs, small photos.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Package cards, hero photo, call-to-action band.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, chips, the stamp. Always fully round.

tokens.name: glow-ember
tokens.usage: Ember glow behind hero photo and call-to-action band. Public pages only.

tokens.name: ring-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on ink surfaces. On cream bands the ring is ink-base.
